WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.location,
         AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio
  FROM event AS e
  JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio,
         RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY location
           ORDER BY average_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
         ) AS rank
  FROM event_averages
)
SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank, event_id
